content: 1. Budesonide, particularly when combined with strong glucocorticoid activity, may increase the risk of hypokalemia. This is especially relevant when used with drugs like metolazone, due to pharmacodynamic synergism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 2. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. 50.
